authorizedRuntimeObservationCoverage.reason: No runtime environment was authorized or queried during this audit.

definitions.fixtureAvailability: A Tool-specific fixture exists, or the Tool from value joins to a ready fixture whose file exists.
definitions.startedAndSucceededInstrumentation: The active route resolves to a component that calls beginToolRun and finishSuccess.
definitions.failedInstrumentation: The active route also has an explicit finishFailure call; character-counter and html-to-markdown do not.
definitions.browserFunctionalFixtureMapping: The smoke runner has a Tool-specific functional path, or the generic renderer has an available input fixture. This is runnable potential, not passing evidence.
definitions.deterministicTestLiteralReference: At least one committed test source contains the exact Tool id as a quoted literal. This is an inventory aid, not proof of functional behavior or a retained result.
definitions.portableRetainedPerToolVerificationEvide: A fresh clone contains no per-Tool result joined to an invariant, revision, environment, scope, and time.
definitions.authorizedRuntimeObservationCoverage: Unknown for every Tool because no runtime environment query was authorized. Gap means evidence unavailable for console ingestion, not success or failure.
